name: Orderchamp Dropshipping
description: Orderchamp GraphQL API for dropshipping channels, publications, inventory, test and live orders, fulfilment, tracking, and webhooks.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: Access Token
credential_fields.description: Private token from the Orderchamp back office or an OAuth access token. Orderchamp must first enable custom dropshipping integrations.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return the authenticated account and its dropshipping and fulfilment capabilities.

constants.query: query GetAccount { account { id name companyName slug type email phone website currency contentLocale userLocale hasDropshippingActivated hasFulfilmentServiceEnabled vacationModeEnabled createdAt updatedAt } }

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List the authenticated retailer's dropshipping channels or webshops.

constants.query: query ListChannels($first: Int, $after: String, $sort: ChannelSort) { channels(first: $first, after: $after, sort: $sort) { nodes { id name url email type behavior status } pageInfo { startCursor endCursor hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } totalCount } }

tools.name: list_publications
tools.description: List products in the dropshipping import list. Use endCursor for pagination and need_update_only for incremental synchronization.

constants.query: query ListPublications($first: Int, $after: String, $needUpdateOnly: Boolean, $sort: PublicationSort) { publications(first: $first, after: $after, needUpdateOnly: $needUpdateOnly, sort: $sort) { nodes { id status createdAt updatedAt failedAt succeededAt channel { id name url } listing { id title brand status contentLocale dropshippingReturns updatedAt variants(first: 100) { nodes { id variantId title sku ean price msrp inventoryQuantity inventoryPolicy updatedAt } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } } } } pageInfo { startCursor endCursor hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } totalCount } }

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Fetch a publication with listing content, variants, prices, inventory, shipping details, and images.

constants.query: query GetPublication($id: ID!) { publication(id: $id) { id status createdAt updatedAt failedAt succeededAt channel { id name url } listing { id title brand description status contentLocale dropshippingReturns createdAt updatedAt category { id name path rawPath } dropshippingShippingDetails { countryGroup fixedCosts variableCosts estimatedShippingDays } translations { en { title description } nl { title description } de { title description } fr { title description } } variants(first: 100) { nodes { id variantId title options { name value } sku ean barcode price msrp currency inventoryQuantity inventoryPolicy position updatedAt } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } images(first: 20, sort: POSITION_ASC) { nodes { id position originalUrl thumbnailUrl transformedUrl(width: 1200, height: 1200, method: FILL) } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } } } }

tools.name: update_publication_status
tools.description: Report a publication sync as success or failed. Inspect data.publicationStatusUpdated.userErrors.

constants.query: mutation UpdatePublicationStatus($input: PublicationStatusUpdatedInput!) { publicationStatusUpdated(input: $input) { publication { id status failedAt succeededAt updatedAt } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: get_inventory_by_sku
tools.description: Get a product variant and its per-location inventory levels by SKU.

constants.query: query GetInventoryBySku($sku: String!) { productVariantBySku(sku: $sku) { id sku ean barcode title productTitle inventory inventoryQuantity inventoryPolicy updatedAt inventoryLevels(first: 100) { nodes { id quantity availableQuantity createdAt updatedAt location { id } } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } } }

tools.name: set_inventory_by_sku
tools.description: Replace inventory for one SKU, optionally at a warehouse. Inspect data.inventoryLevelAdjust.userErrors.

constants.query: mutation SetInventoryBySku($input: InventoryLevelAdjustInput!) { inventoryLevelAdjust(input: $input) { inventoryLevel { id quantity availableQuantity updatedAt location { id } productVariant { id sku } } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: adjust_inventory_by_sku
tools.description: Increase or decrease inventory for one SKU. Negative adjustments subtract stock. Inspect data.inventoryLevelAdjust.userErrors.

constants.query: mutation AdjustInventoryBySku($input: InventoryLevelAdjustInput!) { inventoryLevelAdjust(input: $input) { inventoryLevel { id quantity availableQuantity updatedAt location { id } productVariant { id sku } } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: bulk_adjust_inventory
tools.description: Set or adjust multiple inventory levels. Each item identifies stock by sku, productVariantId, or inventoryLevelId. Inspect userErrors.

constants.query: mutation BulkAdjustInventory($input: InventoryLevelBulkAdjustInput!) { inventoryLevelBulkAdjust(input: $input) { inventoryLevels { id quantity availableQuantity updatedAt location { id } productVariant { id sku } } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: list_ingested_orders
tools.description: List dropshipping orders submitted through the integration, with conversion and product-matching status.

constants.query: query ListIngestedOrders($first: Int, $after: String, $status: IngestedOrderStatus, $since: DateTime, $updatedSince: DateTime, $sort: IngestedOrderSort) { ingestedOrders(first: $first, after: $after, status: $status, since: $since, updatedSince: $updatedSince, sort: $sort) { nodes { id externalOrderId externalOrderNumber externalOrderUrl status paymentUrl retailerOrderId createdAt updatedAt retailerOrder { id number status isTest totalPrice currency } products { id status listingVariant { id variantId sku title } } } pageInfo { startCursor endCursor hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } totalCount } }

tools.name: create_ingested_order
tools.description: Create a dropshipping order. is_test is mandatory: true creates a removable non-fulfilling test; false creates a real order that may be charged and fulfilled. Inspect userErrors and every product status.

constants.query: mutation CreateIngestedOrder($input: IngestedOrderCreateInput!) { ingestedOrderCreate(input: $input) { ingestedOrder { id externalOrderId externalOrderNumber status paymentUrl retailerOrderId createdAt updatedAt retailerOrder { id number status isTest totalPrice currency } products { id status listingVariant { id variantId sku title } } } userErrors { field message name } } }

is_test.description: Use true while integrating. False creates a real order.

tools.name: delete_test_order
tools.description: Permanently delete an ingested test order and free its externalOrderId. Real orders cannot be deleted. Inspect userErrors.

constants.query: mutation DeleteTestOrder($input: IngestedOrderDeleteInput!) { ingestedOrderDelete(input: $input) { deletedIngestedOrderId userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: get_retailer_order
tools.description: Fetch an ingested order's retailer order, supplier orders, line items, shipments, and tracking.

constants.query: query GetRetailerOrder($id: ID!) { retailerOrder(id: $id) { id number status isTest currency subtotalPrice shippingPrice taxPrice totalPrice city country shipDirectlyToCustomer paymentMethod createdAt updatedAt cancelledAt supplierOrders { id number status source isPaid isConfirmed isFulfilled isCancelled currency totalPrice createdAt updatedAt products(first: 100) { nodes { id sku ean title variantTitle quantity unshippedQuantity unitPrice totalPrice listingVariant { id variantId sku } } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } shipments(first: 100) { nodes { id number status externalShipmentId carrier trackingNumber trackingUrl isShipped isDelivered isCancelled shippedAt deliveredAt estimatedDeliveryAt createdAt updatedAt } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } } } }

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List supplier orders. Set is_fulfilled=false to find fulfilment work; exclude unconfirmed and cancelled orders before shipping.

constants.query: query ListOrders($first: Int, $after: String, $isConfirmed: Boolean, $isFulfilled: Boolean, $includeUnconfirmed: Boolean, $includeCancelled: Boolean, $number: String, $source: String, $since: DateTime, $updatedSince: DateTime, $sort: OrderSort) { orders(first: $first, after: $after, isConfirmed: $isConfirmed, isFulfilled: $isFulfilled, includeUnconfirmed: $includeUnconfirmed, includeCancelled: $includeCancelled, number: $number, source: $source, since: $since, updatedSince: $updatedSince, sort: $sort) { nodes { id number status source reference isTest isPaid isConfirmed isFulfilled isCancelled currency productsCount totalPrice confirmedAt estimatedDeliveryAt createdAt updatedAt products(first: 100) { nodes { id sku ean title variantTitle quantity unshippedQuantity unitPrice totalPrice } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } } pageInfo { startCursor endCursor hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } totalCount } }

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch one supplier order with products, invoices, shipments, tracking, and fulfilment state.

constants.query: query GetOrder($id: ID!) { order(id: $id) { id number status source reference note isTest isPaid isConfirmed isFulfilled isCancelled paymentStatus paymentMethod currency subtotalPrice shippingPrice taxPrice totalPrice productsCount paidAt confirmedAt estimatedDeliveryAt deliveredAt cancelledAt createdAt updatedAt products(first: 100) { nodes { id brand title variantTitle sku ean caseQuantity quantity unshippedQuantity unitPrice subtotalPrice taxPrice totalPrice buyingTier { id name quantity reductionType reduction fixedPrice } } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } shipments(first: 100) { nodes { id number status externalShipmentId carrier trackingNumber trackingUrl isShipped isDelivered isCancelled shippedAt deliveredAt estimatedDeliveryAt createdAt updatedAt } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } invoices { id type number currency subtotalPrice taxPrice totalPrice isPaid paidAt createdAt } } }

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a real supplier order. This is consequential; use delete_test_order for tests. Inspect data.orderCancel.userErrors.

constants.query: mutation CancelOrder($input: OrderCancelInput!) { orderCancel(input: $input) { order { id number status isCancelled cancelledAt updatedAt } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments with tracking and delivery state.

constants.query: query ListShipments($first: Int, $after: String, $sort: ShipmentSort) { shipments(first: $first, after: $after, sort: $sort) { nodes { id number status externalShipmentId carrier trackingNumber trackingUrl isShipped isDelivered isCancelled productsCount shippedAt deliveredAt estimatedDeliveryAt createdAt updatedAt order { id number status } } pageInfo { startCursor endCursor hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } totalCount } }

tools.name: get_shipment
tools.description: Fetch one shipment with tracking, order, and shipped products.

constants.query: query GetShipment($id: ID!) { shipment(id: $id) { id number status externalShipmentId carrier trackingNumber trackingUrl isShipped isDelivered isCancelled weight width height length productsCount shippedAt deliveredAt estimatedDeliveryAt createdAt updatedAt order { id number status } retailerOrder { id number status } products(first: 100) { nodes { id sku quantity listingVariant { id variantId sku } } pageInfo { endCursor hasNextPage } totalCount } } }

tools.name: create_shipment
tools.description: Create a shipment from OrderProduct IDs and quantities. Do not use product catalog IDs. Inspect data.shipmentCreate.userErrors.

constants.query: mutation CreateShipment($input: ShipmentCreateInput!) { shipmentCreate(input: $input) { shipment { id number status externalShipmentId productsCount createdAt updatedAt order { id number status } products(first: 100) { nodes { id sku quantity } totalCount } } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: mark_shipment_shipped
tools.description: Mark a shipment shipped with tracking, or explicitly untracked with a delivery timeframe. Inspect userErrors.

constants.query: mutation MarkShipmentShipped($input: ShipmentShippedInput!) { shipmentShipped(input: $input) { shipment { id number status carrier trackingNumber trackingUrl isShipped shippedAt estimatedDeliveryAt updatedAt } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhook registrations and subscribed events.

constants.query: query ListWebhooks($first: Int, $after: String, $sort: WebhookSort) { webhooks(first: $first, after: $after, sort: $sort) { nodes { id databaseId callbackUrl events active template createdAt updatedAt } pageInfo { startCursor endCursor hasNextPage hasPreviousPage } totalCount } }

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Fetch one webhook registration.

constants.query: query GetWebhook($id: ID!) { webhook(id: $id) { id databaseId callbackUrl events active template createdAt updatedAt } }

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook for selected events. The callback must be public HTTPS. Inspect data.webhookCreate.userErrors.

constants.query: mutation CreateWebhook($input: WebhookCreateInput!) { webhookCreate(input: $input) { webhook { id databaseId callbackUrl events active template createdAt updatedAt } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Update a webhook callback, events, active state, or template. Inspect data.webhookUpdate.userErrors.

constants.query: mutation UpdateWebhook($input: WebhookUpdateInput!) { webhookUpdate(input: $input) { webhook { id databaseId callbackUrl events active template createdAt updatedAt } userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete a webhook registration. Inspect data.webhookDelete.userErrors.

constants.query: mutation DeleteWebhook($input: WebhookDeleteInput!) { webhookDelete(input: $input) { deletedWebhookId userErrors { field message name } } }

tools.name: graphql
tools.description: Advanced escape hatch for operations not covered by a named tool. Prefer named tools for safer inputs.

events.name: ORDER_CONFIRMED
events.description: Order confirmed and normally ready for fulfilment.

events.name: PUBLICATION_UPDATED
events.description: Publication content, price, or inventory updated.

registration.manual_setup: Use orderchamp_create_webhook with the generated subscription callback URL. Automatic GraphQL registration will be added separately. Orderchamp signs requests in X-Orderchamp-Signature using the app shared secret.
